topology: Builder -> Fleet PRE -> Ocean -> Fleet POST

rejectionCodes.MISSING_CANDIDATE_SHA: No exact candidate commit SHA was supplied.
rejectionCodes.MISSING_CURRENT_DEFAULT_SHA: No current default-branch HEAD/LKG SHA was supplied.
rejectionCodes.CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT_HEAD: Candidate SHA is not the exact current head being integrated.
rejectionCodes.MISSING_FLEET_PRE_CERTIFICATE: No independent Fleet PRE certificate was supplied; Ocean must never self-certify.
rejectionCodes.STALE_CERTIFICATE: Fleet PRE certificate SHA does not equal the exact candidate SHA.
rejectionCodes.CERTIFICATE_KIND_MISMATCH: Certificate kind is not an independent FLEET_PRE certificate.
rejectionCodes.CERTIFICATE_VERDICT_NOT_PASS: Fleet PRE certificate verdict is not PASS.
rejectionCodes.CERTIFICATE_NOT_COMPLETED: Fleet PRE certificate is missing runId/status and is not a completed run.
rejectionCodes.UNRESOLVED_MERGE_CONFLICT: Merge conflict status is unresolved, unknown or dirty.
rejectionCodes.MISSING_ROLLBACK_LKG: No previous LKG / rollback target was supplied; integration must stay reversible.
rejectionCodes.ROLLBACK_EQUALS_CANDIDATE: Rollback target equals the candidate SHA, so rollback is impossible.
rejectionCodes.DUPLICATE_PARALLEL_SYSTEM: Candidate declares a parallel or duplicate implementation of a canonical Ocean-owned system.
